verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents ships a built-in test framework with LLM judges, plus agent simulations that run end-to-end conversations against an LLM-driven user and evaluate the full interaction. That gives automated AI scoring of agent conversations, but only for pre-deployment testing, not automatic review of real calls. Missing for 10: automatic AI review of production calls, call quality scoring, failure flagging on live traffic, resolution analysis, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
